name: comp-213
blurb: Select with grouped options and category labels.
description: A shadcn Select using SelectGroup and SelectLabel to organize options into logical categories, each with its own header.
use_when: Options fall into natural groups and you want to organize them visually for scanning.
avoid_when: Simple, flat option lists where grouping adds noise.
a11y: Groups are semantic; screen readers understand the structure via optgroup equivalents.
